Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a critical error in Step 1 by prematurely asserting the place of death as "Weimar" in its "Updated Understanding" section without verifying this fact with an authoritative source. While the Planner correctly identified the husband as Goethe, it relied on general knowledge rather than the required systematic gathering of information. This initial assumption created a false consensus that persisted throughout the conversation, leading the Planner to misinterpret subsequent search results (such as the Britannica page showing Frankfurt am Main) as a "discrepancy" rather than a correction of the initial error. The Planner failed to follow its own instruction to "Gather information systematically" and "Build upon previous results" by first establishing the ground truth before attempting to verify it.
